title: fix: resolve CI build errors across plugin-aggrid, plugin-ai, plugin-workflow, and console
body:
CI "Build Core" job fails due to TypeScript errors in `@object-ui/console` (build-breaking) and type errors reported by `vite-plugin-dts` in three plugin packages.

### Changes

- **`apps/console/src/mocks/createKernel.ts`** — Cast `result` to `any` for `_id` property access; the `InMemoryDriver.create()` return type doesn't include `_id`
- **`packages/plugin-aggrid/src/ObjectAgGridImpl.tsx`** — ag-grid 35.x changed `getContextMenuItems` return type from `string` to `DefaultMenuItem` (a string literal union). Updated return type and added import:
  ```ts
  const getContextMenuItems = useCallback(
    (params: GetContextMenuItemsParams): (DefaultMenuItem | MenuItemDef)[] => {
  ```
- **`packages/plugin-ai/`** — Removed `baseUrl`/`paths` overrides from `tsconfig.json` that shadowed root path mappings; moved `@object-ui/*` from `peerDependencies` to `dependencies` (matching `plugin-grid`/`plugin-form` pattern); added type annotations to callback params; fixed `unknown` → `ReactNode` render via `String()`
- **`packages/plugin-workflow/`** — Same dependency fix; added explicit types to `onChange`/`onValueChange` handler params across `ApprovalProcess`, `AutomationBuilder`, and `FlowDesigner`
